summary.text: Ruben Rodriguez is the Republican candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Joan Hartley (D / Independent Party of Connecticut).

paragraphs.text: Rodriguez ran as the Republican candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 72 in 2014, when incumbent Larry B. Butler defeated him in the general election.
His campaign website that year listed priorities including bringing good quality jobs to Waterbury, reducing state spending and taxes, and cleaning up blighted neighborhoods.
Ballotpedia also lists Rodriguez among the withdrawn or disqualified Republican candidates in the 2020 race for U.S. House Connecticut District 5.
